Set watch details including category, origin (country flags), status, dimensions, serial and reference numbers, materials, movement, complications (up to six), pricing, and much more.

CUSTOMIZABLE WATCH PLATES
Change colors of plate, crown, info frame, and font independently to match watch design characteristics. Animated crown, pusher, and gears show watch info.

TRACK WATCH STATISTICS
Track watch collection statistics such as wear rates, accuracy measurements, service history, and compare individual watch specs to your watch collection averages. View a summary of your entire collection.

WEAR HISTORY
Wear history can be examined per watch or for the whole collection. You can filter the wears by day of the week to easily check which watches you tend to wear on sundays as an example. 

ACCURACY MEASUREMENT
Store multiple accuracy measurements for each watch. Check interim result for a measurement while test is active.
Storing the results of each test allows you to compare whether a watch is more accurate on your wrist than in a box or on a winder, for example. If you enable the "Highlight special watches" flip in the settings, then the top-3 most accurate watches will automatically get a special plate design to highlight it. It can be quite fun to see which watches make it to the top-3 and when a watch gets removed from it. 

TIMEGRAPHER ACCURACY MEASUREMENTS
Store results of timegrapher measurements including rate, beat error and amplitude in six positions. WatcheePro automatically calculates averages and deltas based on rate, beat error, and amplitude. Fully-wound and 24-hours running can be compared.

WEAR RATES
Track which watches you wear most often, how many days since last wear, and cost per wear. Watch statistics are just a tap away.
Wear rates can be examined for the whole watch collection and we've also added the per watch effective wear rate, which automatically calculates a percentage for each watch regarding how many times it has been worn compared to the days it has been owned. Wear rates are also available for brands and manufacturing countries, so you can find out how much you wear your watches belonging to a certain brand or watches made in a certain country vs. all other watches. If you enable the "Highlight special watches" flip in the settings, then the most/least worn watches will automatically get a special plate design to highlight it. 

USEFUL AND ENTERTAINING
Export your collection to a spreadsheet. Create PDFs of your watches for insurance or selling purposes. Earn badges for entering watch info and for wear counts. Can't decide what to wear, let WatcheePro pick!

HISTORY LOG
If enabled in the settings, log actions regarding watches such as when a watch is added to the collection or sold.

KEEPER RATE AND SELLER RATE
WatcheePro tracks Keeper & Seller rates for your watches by comparing a specific watch against the other watches in your collection. WatcheePro compares the characteristics of your watch against the averages across your collection.

WATCH COLLECTION SUMMARY DETAILS
Number of watches in collection, number of sold watches, total cost of watches in collection, total retail cost of watches in collection, total cost of sold watches, profit from sold watches, results of watch deals, average diameter, average thickness, average lug-to-lug, and total weight.

APP DEVELOPMENT
WatcheePro stores all data on your device and does not need an internet connection. The app is developed by two watch enthusiasts and programmers. WatcheePro is regularly updated with new features and we welcome feedback.

DEVELOPERS
WatcheePro is developed by Anssi Hakkarainen and Brian Hall. Anssi is a database developer, lifetime programmer, and watch enthusiast. Brian is a computer science professor, engineer, and watchmaker.

Alerts for Mincha prayer times that adjust automatically and in the background according to the date and your location. Can also show the day number of the Hebrew Date in the app icon.

How it works:
- Launch Mincha Alerts once and configure the alerts you wish to receive.
- From now on you'll receive automatically adjusted alerts for the right times for the Mincha prayer.

Benefits:
- When traveling, the reminders will auto adjust to your new location. No need to launch the application.
- Always up to date reminders no matter where you are and what date it is.

Mincha Alerts uses the (new for iOS4) low power significant change of location service to auto-update the alerts without consuming significant power.

Mincha Alerts uses local notifications and thus does not need an active Internet connection for alerts to works.

NOTE: you need a device with cellular capabilities to use this application (such as an iPhone or an iPad 2) - and location services must be turned on.

NEW BONUS: option to show day number of the hebrew date in application icon (badge). This option is turned off by default.

Make the most of your time in the garden.

A typical gardener might only get 40 growing seasons so you’ll want to remember everything that happens in your garden, whether you’re growing vegetables or cut flowers, fruits or shrubs. Keep a journal using thisgarden and take the guesswork out of it.

Add every plant in your garden, with no limits. Whether they're old favourites or just this year's experiment, keep track of everything you sow, plant, pick and harvest. Build your knowledge and look back at everything you accomplish.

Every time you spot something interesting, take a note. Seeing slug damage? You'll want to remember when they first appeared. Dahlia bulbs spent half of April under water? You'll know why they didn't look so great come July.

Look back at last year to see what worked well and what needs adjustment. Did your broad bean seeds sit dormant from February to April before producing a crop over the next 6 weeks? Plant them later this year and use that precious space for something more likely to show a return.

Top Features:

- Mindful Reflection: Immerse yourself in the serene world of gardening journaling. By documenting your journey, you enhance mindfulness, fostering a deeper connection with nature and finding joy in every moment.

- Learn from Experience: Bid farewell to repeated errors! The app allows you to glean insights from your past endeavours. By understanding what works and what doesn't, you can refine your approach, ensuring bountiful harvests without the frustration of trial and error.

- Actionable Insights: Gain valuable knowledge about your gardening practices. Uncover hidden patterns and seasonal trends to make informed decisions and optimise your gardening routine for maximum success.

- Effortless Organisation: Seamlessly manage your gardening tasks. By staying organised, you can effortlessly maintain your garden's health and vitality, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
